page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.medium is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with a single thread per core, meaning hyperthreading is not enabled. The instance is configured with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per CPU core.

This server type does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external block storage volumes for the operating system and application data. It lacks GPU acceleration, containing zero graphics processing units, and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

A key technical tradeoff of the ecs.s3.medium is its highly constrained memory capacity relative to its processing cores, alongside the absence of advanced CPU instruction sets such as AVX, AVX512, AMX, or hardware-assisted cryptography and virtualization flags. This profile makes the instance unsuitable for memory-intensive databases, vector processing, or heavy virtualization. It is best suited for lightweight, compute-bound utility workloads, basic web serving, or task queue workers that require dedicated CPU allocation but have minimal memory footprints.

It offers a dedicated CPU allocation for workloads that require consistent processing performance without the overhead of shared-core resource contention.
